description: This file contains helper methods for creating comments within integration tests for the Comments feature in the application. It includes a method to create a comment, with logic to create a default user if none is specified, and retrieves the created comment from the database context.

methods.name: CreateComment
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a comment based on a provided command and user. If no username is provided, a default user is created. It fetches the created comment from the database to verify creation and returns it.
